sections.label: ActiveSG participation metrics and plans
sections.summary: The passage covers questions on ActiveSG weekly credit use, other success metrics, and plans to boost participation, noting 17 million facility visits in FY2017 and 68% weekly sports participation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) what is the prevalence of regular ActiveSG users, that is, the percentage of users who use their credits on a weekly basis; (b) what other metrics does the Ministry rely on apart from utilisation rates to measure ActiveSG's success in encouraging Singaporeans to lead active lifestyles; and (c) what plans are being considered by the Ministry to boost participation in ActiveSG.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: However, transactions involving ActiveSG credits do not reflect the level of activity among ActiveSG members, as one member can book a facility on behalf of his group, and this excludes those who access our free-to-play facilities, such as our sports stadia.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Since the launch of ActiveSG in 2014, national sports participation has increased.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In financial year 2017, our public sports facilities recorded close to 17 million visits, and the National Sports Participation Survey reported that 68% of respondents participated in sports at least once a week.

sections.label: National Day sports celebration reach
sections.summary: Singapore's week-long National Day sports celebration reached more than 800,000 participants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Singapore, our week-long celebration of National Day through sports, also reached out to more than 800,000 participants.
